prompts.earthHousePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art sprite atlas for a 32x32-tile top-down BYOND RPG, Earth residential architecture.
Create ONE coherent atlas containing exactly FOUR ordinary neighboring-city house sprites, arranged in a precise 2 column by 2 row grid with generous transparent gutters. Every house is a standalone transparent cutout with absolutely NO ground, paving, lawn, platform, fence, people, lettering, cast shadow outside silhouette, background rectangle or checkerboard.
Style: true crisp low-resolution pixel art, restrained 1990s/2000s top-down JRPG mapping tiles, limited muted palette, clear clusters and one-pixel outlines, NO rendered 3D, NO painterly illustration, NO glossy miniature model. Orthographic north-up three-quarter TOP-DOWN game camera: see the broad roof and SOUTH facade; horizontal edges perfectly horizontal, vertical edges perfectly vertical, no isometric diagonal sides, no vanishing point. Identical camera for all houses.
Four modest TWO-storey rectangular townhouses that can sit directly next to each other in a row. Same exterior width, same overall height, same roof ridge height, same facade base line and same centered ground-floor door position. Roof occupies upper half, two-storey front facade lower half. Door is roughly 1/6 of house width and 1/6 house height, sensible for a 32-pixel player.
Top-left: warm cream siding, muted terracotta gabled roof, blue-gray shuttered windows.
Top-right: pale sage stucco, dark slate gabled roof, cream window frames.
Bottom-left: warm red brick, brown-gray tiled gabled roof, sandstone lintels.
Bottom-right: pale blue painted siding, muted navy tiled roof, small window boxes.
Simple straight rectangular wall footprints, roof fills almost full width, tiny eaves only. All south-facing doors centered, with one tiny threshold integrated into facade, no projecting porches. At target scale each house will be 160 pixels wide by 192 pixels tall; think in coarse readable pixel details appropriate to that final size, not tiny photorealistic details.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No labels, no captions, no grid lines. Each sprite fully visible and separated from every other sprite. Original artwork, reference style is compact ordinary modern RPG neighborhoods.
prompts.earthServicesPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2x2 sprite atlas of four ordinary Earth neighborhood public buildings for a 32x32 BYOND RPG.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE only: match its crisp outlined muted pixel-art, north-up roof-and-south-facade camera, perfectly horizontal and vertical edges, window/door proportions and native RPG scale. Create new buildings, do not repeat the houses.
Exactly four isolated rectangular building cutouts, identical size and scale in a precise 2-column 2-row grid, wide genuinely transparent gutters and transparent background, all fully visible. Each building will be normalized to 224x192 pixels (7 tiles wide, 6 high), front door centered and about32pixelswide and40pixelshigh at that scale.
Top-left: modest two-storey neighborhood hospital, ivory brick, slate flat roof with restrained vents, blue medical plus emblem above centered glass double doors, wide readable windows, no words.
Top-right: two-storey corner grocery shop, warm cream walls, muted terracotta roof, green and cream striped awning across ground-floor shop windows and centered single door. No lettering.
Bottom-left: modest two-storey community school/library, warm red brick, low dark hipped roof, simple pale lintels, centered double door, rows of evenly sized windows, small round clock above entrance. No monument, no tower.
Bottom-right: compact one-storey motor repair garage, brick walls, dark gray corrugated roof occupying upper half, two closed garage shutters and a centered narrow personnel door, small blue wrench emblem. No vehicle sticking out.
All roof and wall silhouettes compact, simple and almost rectangular to align next to neighboring houses. No ground/background/paving slab, no standalone plants, no surrounding objects, no cast shadows outside silhouette, no captions, no grid lines, no watermarks, no isometric diagonal side walls, no perspective convergence, no realistic 3D. Real transparent alpha. Coarse crisp pixel clusters readable at target size, avoid tiny detail.
prompts.earthServicesAlphaPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the edit target. Remove the entire fake white and gray checkerboard background from this four-building sprite atlas. Return the EXACT SAME four buildings and arrangement, unchanged colors, shapes, scale, pixel art and details, on a REAL transparent alpha-channel background. Keep all four building silhouettes fully visible. Only change the backdrop to actual transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard or a solid color. Preserve tiny roof vents and chimney, window panes, dark details, glass, walls and doors. No labels, no new objects, no shadows outside silhouettes. Output must be RGBA with genuinely empty transparent pixels in the margins and gutters.
prompts.earthPropsPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small city street furniture sprite atlas for a 32x32-pixel top-down RPG.
Four crisp pixel-art cutouts in a precise 2x2 grid, broad transparent gutters, real transparent alpha background. Common muted colors and south-facing orthographic top-down JRPG perspective, horizontal edges perfectly horizontal. Each object fully visible, no ground slab, no checkerboard, no environment, no labels, no text, no cast shadow outside silhouette.
Top-left: healthy small rounded deciduous street tree, dense green clustered foliage, slim visible brown trunk, alone; designed to read at64x96pixels.
Top-right: simple ordinary wood-slatted public bench with dark iron legs, viewed from above and south; designed to read at64x32pixels.
Bottom-left: modest dark iron street lamp, straight pole, small warm cream rectangular lantern, not ornate, no light halo; designed to read at32x64pixels.
Bottom-right: parked muted blue compact hatchback CAR, viewed from elevated straight front/north-up map view, windshield and roof visible, straight aligned vertical sides; designed to read at64x96pixels.
Medium: true low-resolution pixel-art, clean coarse color clusters, small restrained palette and crisp outlines, readable simple silhouettes. No photographic texture, no painterly rendering, no 3D miniature. Render the actual silhouettes on real transparent alpha.
prompts.earthPropsAlphaPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. EDIT the supplied atlas. Preserve the tree, bench, lamp and blue car exactly and in the same four-cell arrangement. Remove ALL dark background and ALL diffuse colored background glows/halos. The output must have actual transparent RGBA pixels, not black, not a drawn transparency checkerboard. Four clean sprite cutouts only: tree leaves and trunk; bench wood/metal; street lamp including lit lantern but NO aura; car including mirrors and tires but NO shadow. Keep dark outlines, solid windows, pixel art and colors intact. No new art, no labels. Make the entire margin and space between objects actually transparent.
prompts.earthRiverPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque seamless terrain material atlas for a top-down 32x32-tile pixel-art RPG.
Make a precise 2x2 grid of FOUR completely filled square texture swatches, edge-to-edge with NO borders, gaps, labels, shadows or objects. The final target is 32x32 pixels per material, so use coarse restrained pixel clusters, low contrast and a small color palette. This is ground viewed directly from above, not a scene or an illustration.
Top-left: calm freshwater river water, deep muted blue-teal (#477f8a family), a few short subtle horizontal ripples, no checkerboard, no sand, no waves or bright repeating foam.
Top-right: natural temperate meadow grass, muted olive green (#536f42 family), fine low-contrast tufts, no flowers, no trees, no lawn stripes, no checkerboard pattern.
Bottom-left: damp riverbank soil, warm dark beige/earth (#8b8060 family), fine small grit, natural organic texture, no stones larger than 3 target pixels.
Bottom-right: weathered riverbank rock, muted warm gray (#7d8076 family), broad rock facets, subtle dark cracks, no regular brick or cobblestone pattern.
All four swatches perfectly opaque and visually seamless when repeated individually. No directional lighting, no gradients from one edge to another, no visible tile outlines. Consistent native game pixel-art scale. Quiet surfaces to support ordinary townhouses beside a river.
